sentences.en: Today's episode is the last one in our series called You 2.0.
sentences.zh: 今天的这一集是我们“你 2.0”系列的最后一集。

sentences.en: If you haven't heard the other episodes, please take a listen.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过之前的几集，请一定要去听听。

sentences.en: This one comes from our archives.
sentences.zh: 这一集选自我们的档案库。

sentences.en: It's about a tool that humans have used for hundreds of years
sentences.zh: 它讲述的是人类数百年来一直在使用的一种工具，
用来避免一个常见的错误。
这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: All of us have days when despite our best efforts, everything just goes wrong,
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有过这样的日子：尽管我们尽了最大努力，事情却还是搞砸了，
那是一个极其严重的问题。

sentences.en: Atul Gawande is a surgeon at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston.
sentences.zh: Atul Gawande 是波士顿布列根和妇女医院的一名外科医生。

sentences.en: You might have read his work in The New Yorker or in Slate.
sentences.zh: 你可能在《纽约客》或《Slate》杂志上读过他的作品。

sentences.en: A few years ago, Atul was at work operating on a patient he refers to as Mr. Hageman.
sentences.zh: 几年前，Atul 在为一位他称之为 Hageman 先生的病人做手术。

sentences.en: I was taking out a tumor of the adrenal gland laparoscopically.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在通过腹腔镜切除一个肾上腺肿瘤。

sentences.en: He'd performed this procedure dozens of times before, but this time was particularly tricky.
sentences.zh: 他以前做过几十次这种手术，但这一次特别棘手。

sentences.en: Mr. Hageman's tumor was behind his liver, nestled tightly against an important blood vessel.
sentences.zh: Hageman 先生的肿瘤位于肝脏后方，紧贴着一根重要的血管。

sentences.en: The main blood vessel returning the blood of the body to the heart.
sentences.zh: 那是将人体血液回流到心脏的主血管。

sentences.en: It's known as the vena cava.
Atul began the surgery and everything was going smoothly.
sentences.zh: Atul 开始了手术，一切进展顺利。

sentences.en: He was almost done detaching the tumor when all of a sudden, he nicked the blood vessel.
sentences.zh: 就在他快要将肿瘤剥离完毕时，突然间，他划破了那根血管。

sentences.en: I ended up creating a hole in the vena cava, which meant that he then pretty quickly lost his entire blood volume into his abdomen.
sentences.zh: 我最终在腔静脉上弄出了一个洞，这意味着他很快就失去了全身的血液，血液全流进了腹腔。

sentences.en: A complete blackout on the screen and utter chaos.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上一片漆黑，场面极其混乱。

sentences.en: Atul took the man's heart in his hand and began compressing it to keep blood flowing to his brain.
sentences.zh: Atul 用手托住病人的心脏，开始按压，以保持血液流向大脑。

sentences.en: I mean, he lost basically 10 times his body volume in blood, but we were able to give him enough blood to keep his circulation going.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他基本上流失了相当于自身血容量 10 倍的血液，但我们还是设法给他输了足够的血，维持住了他的循环。

sentences.en: He had a cardiac arrest twice.
We were finally able to repair the hole in the vena cava, get the tumor out, and have him recover.
sentences.zh: 我们最终修补好了腔静脉上的洞，取出了肿瘤，并让他康复了。

sentences.en: A happy ending and, at first blush, a textbook case of medical heroics.
sentences.zh: 一个圆满的结局，乍一看，这简直是教科书般的医疗英雄事迹。

sentences.en: A doctor makes a mistake, but he fixes it, taking a heart into his bare hands and squeezing life back into his patient's body.
sentences.zh: 医生犯了错，但他修复了它，用双手托住心脏，将生命重新挤回了病人的体内。

sentences.en: This is the stuff of countless movies and TV shows.
sentences.zh: 这正是无数电影和电视剧里的桥段。

sentences.en: Our whole idea of the hero is the person who can kind of know it all, save the day on their own, just by force of their brain and their skill.
sentences.zh: 我们对英雄的固有印象是：那种无所不知、仅凭大脑和技能就能独自力挽狂澜的人。

sentences.en: But skill and brainpower were not the reason Mr. Hageman survived.
sentences.zh: 但 Hageman 先生能活下来，靠的并不是技能和智力。

sentences.en: Atul says what actually saved his patient's life was a plan the surgical team had made before they began the surgery.
sentences.zh: Atul 说，真正救了病人性命的，是手术团队在手术前制定的一项计划。

sentences.en: The plan wasn't grand or complicated.
sentences.zh: 这个计划并不宏大，也不复杂。

sentences.en: In fact, it was a humble checkliSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它只是一份简单的检查清单。

sentences.en: And what happened was, when we ran the checklist, when we got to the part where we said, you know,
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，当我们执行检查清单时，当我们进行到那一步，我们说，你知道的，

sentences.en: what's the goal of the operation and tell me anything unexpected about this?
sentences.zh: 手术的目标是什么？告诉我这次手术有什么意料之外的情况吗？

sentences.en: And I mentioned to the anesthesiologist that this tumor was pretty tightly against the vena cava.
sentences.zh: 我告诉麻醉师，这个肿瘤紧贴着腔静脉。

sentences.en: The anesthesiologist then made a plan to get more blood into the room, just in case.
sentences.zh: 于是麻醉师制定了一个计划，准备了更多的血放在手术室里，以防万一。

sentences.en: When disaster came, he was prepared.
sentences.zh: 当灾难来临时，他做好了准备。

sentences.en: And that was the only reason that this man got through it.
sentences.zh: 而这正是这位男士能挺过来的唯一原因。

sentences.en: Today on Hidden Brain, the subtle biases that cause very smart and very skilled people to become their own worst enemies
sentences.zh: 今天在《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将探讨那些导致非常聪明、非常有能力的人成为自己最大敌人的微妙偏见，

sentences.en: and how innovators have found a way to help pilots, doctors, frankly, any of us, perform at our beSt.
sentences.zh: 以及创新者们是如何找到方法，帮助飞行员、医生，坦白说，帮助我们所有人发挥出最佳水平的。

sentences.en: It's a story of an ancient insight applied to modern life.
sentences.zh: 这是一个将古老的洞察力应用于现代生活的故事。

sentences.en: And even though you might not know it, this innovation shapes life and death decisions that affect all of us.
sentences.zh: 即使你可能没意识到，这种创新也塑造着影响我们所有人的生死抉择。

sentences.en: We begin in the depths of the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 我们从大萧条时期开始讲起。

sentences.en: It was a time of great suffering and people were looking for inspiration.
sentences.zh: 那是一个充满苦难的时代，人们都在寻求灵感。

sentences.en: Many found it in the heroes who were inventing the modern age of flight.
sentences.zh: 许多人在那些开创现代飞行时代的英雄身上找到了灵感。

sentences.en: One effort in particular caught the public's attention.
sentences.zh: 其中一项努力特别引起了公众的注意。

sentences.en: Boeing was developing an airplane that was said to be different from anything that came before it.
sentences.zh: 波音公司正在开发一种飞机，据说它与以往任何飞机都不同。
保密工作做得非常严密。

sentences.en: The Army's newest bomber and America's largest land plane is prepared for its first flight at Seattle.
sentences.zh: 陆军最新的轰炸机，也是美国最大的陆基飞机，正在西雅图准备进行首次飞行。

sentences.en: In the press, the Model 299 was known as the Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 在媒体上，299 型飞机被称为“飞行堡垒”。

sentences.en: It weighs 15 tons and is reported to have cost nearly half a million.
sentences.zh: 它重达 15 吨，据报道造价近 50 万美元。

sentences.en: Something like the Boeing 299 was a huge story.
sentences.zh: 像波音 299 这样的飞机是一个巨大的新闻。

sentences.en: Roger Connor is a curator at the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: Roger Connor 是华盛顿特区史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆的馆长。

sentences.en: We're standing in a part of the museum dedicated to the golden age of flight,
sentences.zh: 我们正站在博物馆里专门展示飞行黄金时代的区域，

sentences.en: gazing up at a model of Boeing's Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 抬头凝视着波音“飞行堡垒”的模型。

sentences.en: And is that the silver plane that we're looking at up high?
sentences.zh: 我们高处看到的那架银色飞机就是它吗？

sentences.en: Right, so a very streamlined, four-engine aircraft.
sentences.zh: 没错，那是一架非常流线型的四引擎飞机。

sentences.en: And this was really a marvel of its day.
sentences.zh: 这在当时确实是一个奇迹。

sentences.en: In other words, the Model 299 was a big deal, both for Boeing and for the United States.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，299 型飞机对波音公司和美国来说都是一件大事。

sentences.en: It was a success story in America that was really challenged by a depression.
sentences.zh: 它是美国在萧条时期取得的一项成功，确实非常了不起。

sentences.en: It was also a very big deal for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这对美国军方来说也是一件大事。
从各方面来看，它都是一项技术奇迹。

sentences.en: By all accounts, it's a wonder of technology.
sentences.zh: 所以看到它的陆军航空队飞行员们都感到敬畏。

sentences.en: So the Air Corps pilots that see it are in awe.
sentences.zh: 这是一台梦幻般的机器。
这架飞机出现的时代，正是全国上下都沉迷于飞行可能性的时期。

sentences.en: The plane arrived on the scene at a time when the nation was obsessed with the possibilities of flight.
sentences.zh: 航空竞赛不仅仅是富有的业余爱好者的利基活动。

sentences.en: Air racing was not just a niche activity for wealthy hobbyists.
sentences.zh: 它当时是一种全国性的狂热和痴迷。

sentences.en: It was kind of a national craze and obsession.
sentences.zh: 最快的机翼在展示它们惊人的性能。

sentences.en: The fastest things on wings strut their amazing stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，孩子们会痴迷于谁在克利夫兰航空赛中排名领先。

sentences.en: You know, kids would obsess over who was leading the rankings at the Cleveland Air races.
sentences.zh: 军方也同样痴迷于远程轰炸机的构想，

sentences.en: The military was obsessed, too, with the idea of long-range bombers,
sentences.zh: 那种能更好地保护美国海岸线，并在另一场大战爆发时赋予国家优势的飞机。

sentences.en: planes that could better protect the U.S.
sentences.zh: 1934 年，陆军航空队向全国的航空制造公司提出了一个方案，

sentences.en: coastline and give the nation an edge if another great war erupted.
sentences.zh: 挑战他们为军方制造一种新型远程轰炸机。

sentences.en: In 1934, the Army Air Corps put out a proposal to the nation's aviation companies
sentences.zh: 原型机将在第二年的飞行比赛中一决高下。

sentences.en: and challenged them to build a new long-range bomber for the military.
sentences.zh: 两个主要的竞争对手是道格拉斯公司和波音公司。

sentences.en: The prototypes were to go up against each other at a flight competition the following year.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯当时确实开始主导美国飞机制造业。

sentences.en: The two leading competitors are Douglas and Boeing.
sentences.zh: 他们的 DC-2 正在成为热门的客机，

sentences.en: Douglas was really starting to dominate the American aircraft industry at this moment.
sentences.zh: 并迅速让波音在该行业中处于边缘地位。

sentences.en: Their DC-2 was becoming the hot passenger airliner
sentences.zh: 所以一旦航空队宣布这个新的轰炸机竞赛，

sentences.en: and was quickly putting Boeing into the background in that industry.
sentences.zh: 波音公司就非常渴望展示实力，证明他们能引领群雄。

sentences.en: So once the Air Corps announces this new bomber competition,
sentences.zh: 波音有很多东西需要证明。

sentences.en: Boeing is really eager to show off and demonstrate that they can lead the pack.
sentences.zh: 当比赛到来时，他们手里有一张王牌，那就是“飞行堡垒”。

sentences.en: Boeing had a lot to prove.
sentences.zh: 1935 年 10 月 30 日，比赛当天，

sentences.en: By the time the competition rolled around, it had an ace up its sleeve, the Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 波音那架流线型的银色巨兽是明显的领跑者。

sentences.en: On October 30, 1935, the day of the competition,
sentences.zh: 比赛当天早上，来自波音、道格拉斯和马丁公司的飞行团队

sentences.en: Boeing's streamlined silver behemoth was the clear frontrunner.
sentences.zh: 与军方领导人在俄亥俄州代顿的莱特机场集合。

sentences.zh: 那是清晨，嗯，早上 9 点，

sentences.zh: 而且据各方说法，那是一个非常美好的日子。

sentences.en: Early in the morning, well, 9 o'clock in the morning,
sentences.zh: 对于俄亥俄州 10 月下旬的一天来说，条件非常理想。

sentences.en: and apparently, by all accounts, a very beautiful day.
sentences.zh: 确实是试飞的完美日子。

sentences.en: So kind of ideal conditions for a late October day in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 人群注视着波音 299 滑行到跑道上。

sentences.en: And perfect day for a test flight, really.
sentences.zh: 加大油门，引擎转速提升，飞机沿着跑道滑行。

sentences.en: A crowd watched as the Boeing 299 taxied to the runway.
sentences.zh: 这架美丽的飞机升入了空中。

sentences.en: Advances the power, engines spool up, is rolling down the runway.
sentences.zh: 它具备了所有获胜的条件。

sentences.en: The beautiful airplane lifted into the air.
sentences.zh: 然后观察员们注意到飞机开始突然抬头。

sentences.en: It had all the makings of a winner.
sentences.zh: 所以当它起飞时，并没有平稳地爬升和加速，

sentences.en: And then the observers note that the aircraft starts to abruptly pitch up.
sentences.zh: 机头就开始不断地向上翘。

sentences.en: So as it takes off, rather than kind of gradually rising and building up speed,
sentences.zh: 地面上的观察员立刻意识到出事了。

sentences.en: the nose just starts to pick up and up.
And immediately, observers on the ground realize something's wrong.
sentences.zh: 在 300 英尺的高度，飞机失速了。
在人们惊恐的注视下，“飞行堡垒”开始坠向地面。
它以平直的姿态撞击地面，并燃起大火。

sentences.en: As people watched in horror, the Flying Fortress began to plummet toward the earth.
It impacts the ground in a flat attitude and bursts into flames.

sentences.en: who was one of the aeronautical engineers involved with the program.

sentences.zh: 所以，在这种情况下，因为飞机是相对平着落地的，

And so when, in this case, because the aircraft came down relatively flat,

it would have been fairly apparent to the people on the ground

So it's going to be a great hazard to both the rescuers

sentences.en: as well as the occupants of the aircraft.

和今天的许多事故一样，

and not unlike a lot of accidents today,

这是该飞机的高级功能之一，

sentences.zh: 都会在驾驶“飞行堡垒”时犯下致命错误，

At this moment in the mid-1930s,
